about: Constants for combine() (src/criteria/combine.ts). Each number has value, bounds (min, max), neutral (the starting point the fit is pulled back towards) and fixed (true = the owner's choice, never fitted). Fitted by `npm run fit`; see calibration/FIT.md.

pages.about: One web page. The total is combine() over the four sub-scores (content, layout, style, visual; each already the lower of the averaged and the noticed-faults reading). The twelve criteria are measured and shown to the player (criteria, criteriaFeedback) but do not set the total: on the human bands they track judgement less well than the sub-scores (calibration/fit/pages-diagnosis.md, pages-variants.md).

content.meaning: Does the page say the right things.

weight.meaning: Share of the score for content (owner's choice).

layout.meaning: Is it built and arranged like the goal.

weight.meaning: Share of the score for layout (owner's choice).
Share of the score for style (owner's choice).
Share of the score for the visual match (owner's choice).

content.meaning: Content sub-score: the right words, facts and sections, nothing extra.

gamma.meaning: Curve on value**gamma: above 1 every slip costs more, the first ones most; below 1 small slips cost less and big ones more; 1 = straight line.

layout.meaning: Layout sub-score: built and arranged like the goal.

gamma.meaning: Curve on value**gamma: above 1 every slip costs more, the first ones most; below 1 small slips cost less and big ones more; 1 = straight line.

style.meaning: Style sub-score: colours, fonts, corners and borders.

gamma.meaning: Curve on value**gamma: above 1 every slip costs more, the first ones most; below 1 small slips cost less and big ones more; 1 = straight line.

visual.meaning: Visual sub-score: side by side, it looks like the goal.

gate.meaning: Something pretty that does not work is useless: looks count for less when the content is not there. `by` is the content criterion, or the content group when that criterion is absent.

floor.meaning: Least share of looks credit kept when content is zero (1 = gate off).

knee.meaning: Content level from which looks get full credit.

pages.status: Not adopted (2026-11-15): best variant passes leave-one-set-out but breaks 4 page tests; see calibration/fit/pages-variants.md. Values are neutral; grading does not read this file yet.

sites.about: Stub. Groups will be the pillars works 0.40, engineering 0.35, looks 0.25 (fixed by the owner), and the engineering pillar is the weakest of its measures (min, not a weighted mean); that rule stays in the site grader, not here. Fill in criteria when the site criteria list exists.
